name: lookup_term
description: Find out what a term, acronym, codename, repo, service, or person refers to, and whether what you heard is the canonical spelling. Use this before asking them to repeat a word. Checks the learned lexicon first, then the host's glossary.

heard.description: The term exactly as the transcriber produced it, including a wrong spelling.

context.description: The sentence it appeared in, so homonyms can be told apart.

returns.description: matches[] each with canonical, kind, definition, aliases, and confidence. High confidence means use the canonical form silently. Low confidence and a load-bearing term means ask.
